purpose: Represent how Flower actually changed so recurring improvement mechanisms can be tested without treating narrative history as causal proof.

episodes.observedTrigger: Identical methodology proposal/evidence pairs were repeatedly reevaluated.
episodes.collapsedState: semantic novelty and textual/repeated invocation were treated too similarly
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Recognize semantic equivalence and reuse prior assessment unless evidence materially changes.
episodes.observedOutcome: 99 of 100 rediscoveries reused prior assessments while materially new evidence retained a reopen path.
episodes.falsifier: Reuse changes the assessment, blocks new evidence, or fails to reduce redundant reevaluation.

episodes.observedTrigger: The Utopia first-fruit experiment produced code, deployment, and methodology progress while confirmed economic Fruit remained zero and the search became attached to an early branch.
episodes.collapsedState: internal progress, branch momentum, and terminal value were insufficiently separated
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Split terminal outcome from proxies; make challengers, distribution, fulfillment, branch metabolism, and action-vs-recursion explicit.
episodes.instrument: terminal objective lock plus champion/challenger and recursion budget
episodes.observedOutcome: The methodology stopped counting internal sophistication as Fruit and made branch replacement and action pressure executable.
episodes.falsifier: Comparable runs increase churn or delay strong terminal action without producing materially better decisions.

episodes.observedTrigger: Useful artifacts and even gross revenue could exist without proving useful external value, attributable return, full-cost surplus, legitimate ownership, or regeneration.
episodes.collapsedState: value, capture, revenue, surplus, entitlement, and abundance were too coarse
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Split the economic loop into separately verified value, return, cost, surplus, ownership, and allocation states.
episodes.observedOutcome: The first implementation self-audit caught narrative fields masquerading as verified value and ownership, then tightened promotion gates.
episodes.falsifier: The added gates systematically block valuable actions before the distinctions can affect a real decision.

episodes.observedTrigger: The canonical methodology had evolved but the active reasoner still reconstructed an older passivity-first economic objective and was not receiving the canonical methodology in its cognition payload.
episodes.collapsedState: documented governance and executable cognition were treated as if they were equivalent
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Require executable cognition to receive and obey the canonical methodology rather than merely coexist with it.
episodes.instrument: methodology-bearing reasoner view and regenerative candidate schema
episodes.observedOutcome: Search cognition began receiving the current methodology and comparing complete value/return/cost/regeneration paths rather than passivity alone.
episodes.falsifier: Passing the canonical methodology into cognition adds burden without changing or improving any decision.

episodes.observedTrigger: Live x402 flow showed that transaction activity, buyer breadth, repeat use, advertised supply, and captured value could diverge sharply.
episodes.collapsedState: activity was an inadequate proxy for demand
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Instrument value flow and separate supply, activity, buyer breadth, repeat, and return before creating new economic form.
episodes.observedOutcome: The sensor improved internal search resolution, but one habitat was insufficient to justify a universal methodology law.
episodes.falsifier: Across other habitats, flow instrumentation fails to improve selection or costs more than it changes decisions.

episodes.observedTrigger: Repeated useful internal transformations could either remain trapped inside Flower or be prematurely productized as if internal usefulness proved external value.
episodes.collapsedState: self-improvement, transferability, and external value were insufficiently separated
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Prove multidimensional internal gain first, then derive at most one bounded transfer hypothesis whose external value stays unverified.
episodes.instrument: dual-dividend membrane plus bounded TRANSFER pressure
episodes.observedOutcome: Tests showed one bounded transfer analysis can crystallize an unverified transfer seed and converge without turning a local gain into external-value truth.
episodes.falsifier: Transfer analysis usually creates generic non-actionable abstractions, repeated cognition, or terminal delay.

episodes.observedTrigger: Raw CI timing changed substantially between revisions even when the causal implementation had not changed, and Git commit identity was too coarse for self-improvement comparison.
episodes.collapsedState: repository revision, causal implementation change, and performance change were too easily conflated
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Compare stable workloads using causal implementation fingerprints and promotion-quality dimensions; retain noisy timing as observation only.
episodes.instrument: self-improvement Observatory with causal file fingerprint
episodes.observedOutcome: A later run with much lower raw latency correctly remained 'no self-improvement observed' because the causal fingerprint was unchanged and speed was non-promotional.
episodes.falsifier: The declared causal file set misses code capable of changing the measured workload or blocks legitimate comparisons.

episodes.observedTrigger: The targeted cognition payload stayed nearly constant as the Garden grew, but neighborhood resolution still scanned the geometry twice.
episodes.collapsedState: sparse transmitted state and sparse internal activation work were treated as if they were the same efficiency property
episodes.decisionRelevantMove: Instrument exact geometry-record visits separately from payload size before optimizing activation.
episodes.observedOutcome: At 5,000 centers, the payload remained 23,559 bytes and preserved one target while neighborhood resolution examined 10,000 geometry records.
episodes.falsifier: A causal activation change cannot reduce record visits without degrading the same decision witness or complexity capacity.
